Polypipe Ulster, part of the Genuit Group, designs and manufactures products for the domestic, commercial, and industrial construction sectors.
Our exceptional teams apply their first-class technical, customer service and manufacturing expertise to understand our customers’ needs and solve tomorrow’s water, climate, and ventilation challenges. Our loyal and highly skilled workforce are key to our success of delivering sustainable climate and water management solutions, everywhere.

The Territory Sales Representative is responsible for maintaining and developing their own customer portfolio, with a keen focus on account management, to capitalise on customer relationships, follow up leads and maximise the potential for growth of all Genuit Group Products to our merchant partners and Contractors.

Develop and maintain strong trading relationships with existing customers, monitoring performance and buying behaviour.
Maximise sales and profit by applying strong product knowledge and providing solution‑based support to customers.
Monitor market activity to anticipate challenges and opportunities within the territory.
Grow the Genuit product portfolio within the defined region to add value for merchant partners and contractors.
Build and manage a target list of prospects to increase market share.
Conduct regular branch reviews with key merchant partners to develop product ranges and strengthen relationships.
Develop and manage a healthy project pipeline, including targeting and supporting contractors, specifiers and M&E consultants.
Analyse customer sales data using tools such as Excel, QlikView and databases to inform decision‑making.
Collaborate with marketing teams on promotions, trade events and sales collateral to support territory growth.
Represent Genuit Group at sales meetings, training sessions and marketing events such as trade shows.

Significant experience in construction industry solution selling.
Strong ability to communicate concepts, promotions, products and services through a variety of media.
Strong market awareness of the construction industry.
Ability to listen and professionally resolve customer concerns.
Eligibility to work in ROI.
Full clean driving licence.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage individuals at all levels.
Ability to work independently and prioritise a wide variety of tasks.
Here at the Genuit Group we recognise and develop the contribution our people make to the Group’s success and are committed to attracting talent from the widest pool. We have a role to play in making the built environment more sustainable, building a low carbon business ourselves as well as delivering sustainable solutions at scale.

Location Our Sales Development Representative will be an integral part of our DoiT Cloud Intelligence (DCI) sales team. This role is fully remote. We are hiring for this position across EMEA, specifically in the UK, the Netherlands, Ireland, Belgium and Switzerland.

Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more.

An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityAs a Sales Development Representative for DoiT Cloud Intelligence (DCI), you will be responsible for outbound lead generation, including email, calling, and using LinkedIn to book demos with qualified prospects in your region.

You’ll be on the front line of the sales team, collaborating closely with the regional Field Sales teams and progress the qualified pipeline with Account Executives (AE) by focusing on the primary metrics of qualified meetings booked and pipeline generated .

We are looking for an agile, "startup-minded" individual who is ready to learn quickly and evolve as we scale. You will also build internal relationships with our sales, marketing, and cloud vendor teams.

Responsibilities Set meetings via outbound prospecting through both automated and manually-driven campaigns to achieve daily and monthly pipeline targets. Partner closely with Account Executives to ensure tight alignment on territory planning, account prioritization, and feedback loops to maximize pipeline quality.

Help build and refine our outbound motion by identifying and reaching decision-makers. Build, manage, and optimize multi-channel outbound campaigns at scale using various tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Clay, etc.

Own the outbound process end-to-end, from detailed account research to ensuring a qualified meeting is successfully booked for the Account Executive team. Partner with leadership to refine messaging, call scripts, and multi-channel outreach strategies to improve conversion rates and outbound effectiveness.

Support Regional GTM & Marketing activities across digital and onsite formats. Clearly communicate compelling value propositions to technical buyers and stay current with the latest product and service information.

Stay current with the latest offering/product/service information Some travel may be required Qualifications 1–3+ years of SDR/BDR experience in Cloud, preferably with a background in selling to technical decision makers such as CTO, VP Engineering or Head of DevOps. Proven experience selling SaaS B2B or cloud products or services.

Proven history of achieving and reaching for results in an outbound lead generation environment. Experience managing multiple priorities and juggling various tools or campaigns in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Goal-oriented and self-motivated mindset with the "grit" to work through challenges and multiply sales speed.

Ability to exercise a high degree of autonomy and sales authority while remaining highly organized. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and French. Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally. What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge and having fun!

Click here to learn more about our core values . Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page . We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

What You Get: A market competitive commission plan, with uncapped commission potential and accelerators Work within a hyper-growth sales environment with a variety of career advancement opportunities Opportunities to further develop and refine your sales acumen by partnering with our seasoned leaders Direct access to senior executive leadership Expected Full-Time Base Salary: $130K-$150K with uncapped commission potential This range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary/wage.

You'll find a culture that supports open communication, embracing failure as a learning opportunity, and always being open to new ideas—no matter how radical.

We are a remote-first company, however some pharmacy operations roles require onsite clinic presence. We’re committed to creating a positive and collaborative culture to achieve our mission, all while supporting our team members in all aspects of their lives—at home, at work and everywhere in between.

In particular, we offer: Flexible work hours and flexible paid time off Generous parental leave Comprehensive healthcare, vision and dental benefits Competitive salary and equity stake We’re backed by forward-thinking investors committed to transforming healthcare, including Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital, LRV Health, NEA, Town Hall Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Maverick Ventures, 1984.vc, and Character.

We are a dynamic AI start-up based in the heart of Munich, setting the global standard for AI Coaching. While most AI companies are working on replacing human labor, we are unlocking the uniquely human strengths that drive lasting business outcomes for our enterprise clients.

Our in-house AI technology helps sales and service teams at global enterprises earn trust and win deals through realistic client simulations and deep behavioral feedback. Join our international team that is not just building a human-centric product, but redefining customer relationships.
About the role (Munich-based, German speaking): You are the tip of the spear for our enterprise motion in DACH. Paired one to one with a Senior Account Executive, you own the top of the funnel.

You research target accounts, reach the right people through cold calls, email and LinkedIn, and open conversations with senior commercial buyers in Sales Enablement and Commercial Excellence. This is a dedicated pod, not a shared pool. You feed a proven closer, learn enterprise selling from the inside, and grow into an Account Executive yourself.
Tasks
Generating qualified pipeline through proactive, multi-channel outbound: cold calls, personalized email sequences, and LinkedIn, into your target accounts
Researching accounts and buying centers, and identifying the right senior stakeholders in Sales Enablement, Commercial Excellence, and Service Ownership
Running crisp first conversations that qualify need and book meetings your paired Account Executive accepts
Working hand in hand with one senior Account Executive in a dedicated 1:1 pod: shared account plans, daily coordination, joint territory strategy
Keeping the CRM (HubSpot) clean and disciplined, so pipeline, activities, and handoffs stay reliable
Testing and improving messaging, sequences, and target lists together with marketing and your AE
Using Retorio's own platform to sharpen your outbound and discovery skills, and to know the product you sell from the inside

2 to 4 years of B2B SaaS outbound experience as an SDR or BDR, ideally into enterprise
A track record of consistently hitting or beating pipeline and meeting targets, with real numbers you can speak to
Strong on cold outbound: you can open a cold call, steer the conversation, and handle objections without a script
Business-fluent German (C1+) and English, the role is Munich-based and sells into the DACH market
Coachable, self-driven, and resilient: you seek feedback, act on it, and stay in the game through rejection
A clear ambition to grow into an Account Executive (see the path below)
Comfortable with modern outbound tooling: CRM (HubSpot), sales engagement, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and data enrichment
Bonus: experience selling into Pharma, Telco, FMCG, Insurance, Automotive, or Retail, or into sales enablement, coaching, or L&D-adjacent buyers

From the preset toggles, enable: Above-average compensation, Flexible working hours, and High-performance culture. As custom entries:
Uncapped commission with a competitive OTE: your earnings scale with the pipeline and the deals you help create
A clear path to Account Executive: this role is built as a launchpad, with a realistic move to AE in 18 to 24 months, and faster for a standout performer
A dedicated 1:1 partnership with a senior Account Executive who coaches you every week, not a shared BDR pool
Six-figure enterprise deals and reference clients across pharma, insurance, telecom, FMCG, retail and automotive
Direct access to the founders and real influence on how we sell
A product with a genuine scientific moat, built on the Warmth and Competence framework from TU Munich research, that you also use to get better yourself
A central Munich office with an international team
If you want to break into enterprise sales the right way, learning from a senior closer while building the pipeline that wins six-figure deals, send us your CV and a short note on the best cold call or outbound sequence you have run. You will hear back within a week, and the process is fast: intro call and deep dive with your future AE partner, a practical case that includes a live cold-call exercise and a conversation with a founder.

Prospect daily through cold calls, outbound outreach, networking, and referrals

Build and grow a profitable book of freight business

Originally posted on Himalayas

The Reality of This Role This is not a "relationship management" role or a "check-the-box" administrative position. We are looking for a pure hunter who thrives on the road and views a "No" as a tactical puzzle to be solved. If you require a desk, a steady routine, or a manager to tell you who to call next, do not apply.

Who You Are (The Top 10%) Self-Governed: You don’t need a GPS to find a target. You own your territory like it’s your own franchise. Fluent in Results: You don't brag about how many "calls" you made; you brag about the revenue you closed.

Resilient: You have the "softball" mentality for people—gentle enough to build instant rapport—but the "hardball" mentality for the deal. Elite Communicator: You possess near-native command of English (C1/C2 level) and preferably one or more European languages to negotiate with C-suite executives and navigate complex objections.

The Mission (Days on Road) 80% Field Presence: You will spend 4 days a week on the road. You will be expected to master your territory through face-to-face combat—meeting prospects where they live and work. Strategic Hunting: You will identify, qualify, and close high-value accounts independently. Full Accountability: You manage your own pipeline.

We provide the CRM; you provide the data that shows why you’re winning. What We Offer (The Upside) Uncapped Commissions: We don't believe in "ceiling" your success. If you bring in the revenue, you keep the lion's share. Zero Micro-Management: We don't care where you are at 10:00 AM as long as your numbers are at 120% of quota.

High-Stakes Environment: You will be surrounded by other high-performers. If you are the smartest person in the room, you are in the wrong room. Requirements Proven Track Record: You can provide a 12-month stack-ranking showing you in the top decile of your previous sales force.

Mobility: A European driving licence and a willingness to be "on the road" constantly. Stamina: Physical and mental endurance for long days and high-pressure negotiations. Fully Remote, Europe Originally posted on Himalayas

At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1 st , 2026, you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Institutional & Specialty divisions, Ecolab offers comprehensive chemical products and solutions to meet the needs of customers across the foodservice and hospitality industries as well as laundry, long-term care, education, corporate and government facilities.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and advisor to your customers. You will serve as the face of Ecolab, providing recommendations on advanced cleaning and sanitation processes and programs that drive a positive guest experience and create cleaner, safer, and healthier environments.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn customers’ ware washing & laundry systems and work hands‑on with equipment, learning installation, maintenance and safe use, ensuring that your customers’ facilities are fully operational and teams are properly trained
Gradually build confidence in identifying new opportunities and growing your territory providing customers with training, regular and emergency service and sales demonstrations
Coordinate sales and service activities with cross divisional peers and internal functions (e.g. Marketing Services, Customer Service).
Reach out to potential customers to secure new accounts, as you build Ecolab’s brand in your market
What you’ll need?
We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:

s.h: Have completed vocational training or equivalent education
s.t:
Have some experience in customer‑facing, sales, service or hospitality environments, preferably business to business commercial sales experience
Have basic installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting skills
Are eager to learn, open to feedback and motivated to continuously develop new skills
Have demonstrated problem solving skills and creative thinking
Are comfortable adapting to new situations and challenges
Have a desire to grow your career in Sales and Service-related roles
Have basic IT skills (CRM experience is helpful) Hold a valid driver's license and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record and are open to travelling within your allocated district and nationwide
No Immigration Sponsorship available

A 12‑month fixed‑term contract, that may lead to a permanent position, depending on business need
A robust, structured training programme, that includes job shadowing, e-learning modules, structured field activities, and customized classroom style training, with clear development milestones
A supportive environment where coaching and feedback are part of everyday work, allowing you to learn from subject matter experts with proven success
The opportunity to carve out a long term, advanced career path in sales, within a business that recognises the talent to progress
25 days holiday plus 8 days Bank Holiday
4% Flexible Benefits Allowance. A wide range of benefits (extended to families) or to be used as salary increase
Pension with 7% Employer Contribution and 4 x annual salary Life Insurance benefits
Receive a company vehicle for business and personal use
Income growth opportunities as you progress and develop in the role
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Ecolab, we believe the best teams are diverse and inclusive, and we are on a journey to create a workplace where every associate can grow and achieve their best. We are committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants.

We recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement on the basis of individual qualifications and job performance.

In all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement, we will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, colour, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, disability, or status as a covered veteran.

Industrieunternehmen in der Region Mittelland, die noch keine Kunden sind, identifizieren und aktiv akquirieren.
Qualifizierte Termine vereinbaren, den Bedarf im Bereich Sonderabfallentsorgung erfassen und passende Lösungen entwickeln.

Was uns antreibt
Bei CRIDEC steht Schutz an erster Stelle: Das ist der eigentliche Sinn unserer Arbeit. Wir handeln lieber vorausschauend, als Entwicklungen hinzunehmen, halten unsere Versprechen auch dann ein, wenn es schwierig wird, und gehen den Weg gemeinsam, mit gegenseitiger Wertschätzung.

In dieser Position bekommen diese Werte eine ganz konkrete Bedeutung: Jedes einem Interessenten gegebene Versprechen wird eingehalten, jede angekündigte Nachfassaktion wird durchgeführt, und jeder gewonnene Kunde wird gut betreut.

s.h: Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks
s.t:
This is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is friendly and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:
Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? Employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!
Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.
Work-Life Synergy: Our Team members start with 3 weeks of PTO each year and can earn up to 6 weeks each year! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday! Work hard, play hard!
Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families! Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: A key component to living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well as Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins on the 1st of the month after you start.
Team Building: We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.
Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

## ##
Unsere versierten Mitarbeitenden in der Betriebsführung steuern die Anlage rund um die Uhr und sorgen für einen störungsfreien Betrieb des Kraftwerks. Nutzen Sie die Gelegenheit und starten Sie bei uns die mehrjährige Ausbildung zum Pikettingenieur.
## **Was Sie erwartet:** ##
* Eine systematische Weiterbildung vom Anlagen- bzw. Reaktoroperateur über den Schichtchef bis zum Pikettingenieur. Die Weiterbildung im Betrieb der Anlage umfasst sowohl fachtechnische Inhalte als auch Führungskompetenzen. Sie findet intern im Ressort Ausbildung und am eigenen Simulator statt sowie extern an der Nukleartechnikerschule in Baden (http://www.kernenergie.ch/).
* Als Pikettingenieur werden Sie vom Schichtleiter zugezogen, wenn das Anlageverhalten vom Normalzustand abweicht und unterstützen situativ mit Ihrer Expertise.
* In Ihrer Funktion als Pikettingenieur nehmen Sie regelmässig an Weiterbildungskursen sowie vielseitigen Simulatorschulungen teil und übernehmen gleichzeitig Verantwortung in einem technischen Fachbereich.
## **Was Sie auszeichnet:** ##
* Sie haben ein Fachhochschulstudium im Bereich Elektro- oder Maschineningenieurwesen oder ein Ingenieurstudium an einer technischen Hochschule erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
* Sie zeichnen sich durch Ihre Bereitschaft zur intensiven Aus- und Weiterbildung aus. Das ideale Einstiegsalter liegt zwischen 25 und 35 Jahren.
* Herausfordernde, neue und wechselnde Situationen bewältigen Sie überlegt, flexibel und fachkundig.
* Sie sind ein Teamplayer, übernehmen aber auch gekonnt den Lead und leiten sowie begleiten Ihr Team in normalen wie auch besonderen Situationen professionell.
* Sie schätzen die Vorzüge der Schichtarbeit (3-Schichtbetrieb) während der Ausbildung und die Bereitschaft zu unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten und Pikettdiensten (inkl. Nacht- und Wochenenddienste).
* Sprachkenntnisse: Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend notwendig, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
## **Was wir bieten:** ##
* Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem etablierten, technisch versierten und verantwortungsbewussten Unternehmen
* Gezielte Förderung von Fachkenntnissen und Kompetenzen
* Marktgerechte Löhne kombiniert mit einem attraktiven Paket an zusätzlichen Leistungen
* Hervorragende Pensionskassenlösungen zur Absicherung der Zukunft
* Genussvolle Verpflegung im firmeneigenen Personalrestaurant
* Ein Arbeitsumfeld, das von gegenseitigem Respekt, Teamgeist und einer offenen Kommunikationskultur geprägt ist.
Sie sind technisch versiert, lieben Herausforderungen und möchten dabei mitwirken, dass alles reibungslos läuft - dann suchen wir genau Sie! Als Pikettingenieur übernehmen Sie Verantwortung und stellen mit Ihrem Fachwissen sowie Ihrem Engagement sicher, dass unsere Anlage rund um die Uhr zuverlässig funktioniert.

**Help organisations stay one step ahead of cyber threats **
Cyber attacks are no longer a question of if, but when. While prevention remains important, organisations increasingly rely on their ability to detect threats early, respond effectively, and recover quickly.
At Deloitte, we help some of Switzerland's largest and most critical organisations build and transform their cyber defence capabilities. From designing Cyber Defence Centres and Security Operations Centres to improving incident response, deploying security technologies, and exploring AI-enabled security operations, we help our clients strengthen their resilience against an ever-evolving threat landscape.
If you are passionate about cyber defence, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, this is the opportunity for you.
**How you can make an impact **
As a Cyber Detect & Respond Advisor, you will work alongside experienced cyber professionals to help clients prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats and attacks.

* Assess and improve cyber defence capabilities, including Security Operations Centres (SOC), Cyber Defence Centres (CDC), Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, and Vulnerability Management
* Help clients design practical and effective cyber defence strategies, operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
* Design, implement, configure, and optimise cyber defence technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management platforms
* Support the development of detection use cases, monitoring capabilities, automation workflows, and security operations processes
* Conduct cyber defence assessments, maturity reviews, and benchmarking exercises to identify improvement opportunities
* Support incident response readiness activities, including playbook development, tabletop exercises, and crisis preparedness initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help clients understand how innovations such as AI-powered security operations can enhance detection and response capabilities
* Work closely with specialists across Deloitte to deliver integrated cyber security solutions that create measurable value for clients
* Contribute to business development, thought leadership, and the continued growth of Deloitte's Detect & Respond practice

We are looking for curious and motivated professionals who combine technical expertise with a desire to make a real impact. You bring:
* Approximately 5+ years of professional experience in cyber security, cyber defence, security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, cyber engineering, or a related field
* A passion for helping organisations prepare for and respond to cyber threats
* Practical experience in one or more areas such as Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, Digital Forensics, or Cyber Defence
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, XSIAM, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, EDR, NDR, SIEM, or similar solutions
* Understanding of modern threat actors, attack techniques, and cyber defence best practices
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* Curiosity, drive, and a desire to continuously learn and develop

* Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Cyber Defence Centre (CDC), CSIRT, or Incident Response team
* Exposure to AI-enabled security operations, security automation, detection engineering, or threat validation
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent
* University degree in a relevant field (Bachelor's or Master's)
* Fluent English; German and/or French are an advantage
**Your team**
You will join a diverse, international, and highly collaborative team of cyber security professionals who are passionate about helping organisations strengthen their resilience against cyber threats.
What makes our team different is the opportunity to work across the full cyber defence lifecycle. One day you may be helping a client define their future Cyber Defence Centre strategy, the next designing security monitoring capabilities, improving incident response processes, or supporting the implementation of leading security technologies.
We believe that great careers are built through challenging work, continuous learning, and strong support. You will benefit from hands-on experience, dedicated mentoring, professional certifications, and collaboration with experts across Deloitte's global network.
Most importantly, we foster an open and inclusive culture where people are encouraged to bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and shape the future of cyber defence.
Ready to make an impact?
Join us and help organisations build the capabilities they need to detect threats faster, respond smarter, and emerge stronger from cyber incidents. Your next challenge starts here.
**Careers at Deloitte. **
Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects.

At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation.

Pourquoi choisir CONCORDIA?
La santé est au cœur de nos préoccupations. C'est pourquoi nous nous engageons à offrir à nos collaborateurs et collaboratrices un environnement de travail positif et valorisant, caractérisé par des tâches variées, des équipes polyvalentes et une ambiance conviviale.

Par ailleurs, nous mettons un point d'honneur à promouvoir le développement professionnel au sein de l'entreprise. Avoir du plaisir à travailler tout en faisant ses preuves, c'est possible chez CONCORDIA. Car une vie professionnelle enrichissante constitue un vrai plus pour la santé!
Notre diversité est notre capital : CONCORDIA réunit des personnes de cultures, de métiers et de domaines de responsabilité différents. Vas-tu également enrichir notre équipe prochainement ? Pour notre agence à Fribourg et Bulle, nous recherchons des personnes polyvalentes et ouvertes d'esprit comme toi.
# Conseiller ou conseillère à la clientèle (f/m/nb), 60-80 % à Fribourg et Bulle #
**Tes responsabilités**
* Dans un contexte varié, tu conseilles par téléphone et en face à face, tu prospectes de nouveaux clients et vends des solutions d'assurance maladie et de prévoyance adaptées à leurs besoins.
* Tu gères de manière autonome et proactive le suivi des assurés existants ainsi que les contacts clients quotidiens.
* Tu établis des offres, effectues des tâches administratives et fixes des rendez-vous avec des clients potentiels.
* Tes idées sont les bienvenues : tu participes à des actions lors de foires ou de stands et représentes CONCORDIA sur place.
**Ton profil**
* Tu as achevé une formation professionnelle de base dans un environnement orienté vers la vente et tu maîtrises bien l'utilisation de l'ordinateur.
* Tu as une excellente maîtrise du français, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit - un atout essentiel pour des entretiens de conseil réussis. Et tu possède des connaissances en allemand ? Un vrai plus qui fait la différence.
* La vente et le conseil sont tes passions : tu as un bon contact avec les gens et tu peux t'appuyer sur un réseau existant que tu développes continuellement.
* La communication est ton point fort : tu as une attitude assurée et tu convaincs par ta manière ouverte et sympathique. Travailler de manière autonome et responsable va de soi pour toi.
* Tu as terminé la formation AFA ou tu es motivé·e à la suivre - nous t'accompagnons dans cette démarche.
**Tes avantages**
* Dans le cadre du congé maternité, le salaire est intégralement versé durant 14 semaines. CONCORDIA accorde des allocations supplémentaires pour enfant et de formation professionnelle et prend en charge jusqu'à 90 % des frais de garde des enfants.
* CONCORDIA soutient ta participation à des formations internes et externes et t'aide à planifier ta carrière.
* CONCORDIA te propose une caisse de pension particulièrement attrayante, sûre, avec des cotisations de l'employeur supérieures à la moyenne et des prestations généreuses.
* Ta famille et toi bénéficiez de primes d'assurance-maladie réduites.
* Nous accordons une grande importance au repos: tu profites d'au moins cinq semaines de congés payés par année.
* Nous récompensons la collaboration de longue date. À partir de cinq ans de service, tu bénéficies à intervalles réguliers d'un cadeau d'ancienneté sous forme de vacances ou d'une prime.

Vous souhaitez relever un nouveau défi et contribuer activement au développement de notre activité de gestion de fortune ? Nous nous réjouissons de faire votre connaissance.
**Conseiller(ère) en gestion de fortune & prévoyance (f/h)**
**Qu'est-ce qui vous attend?**
· Gérer, fidéliser et développer un portefeuille de clients grâce à un accompagnement personnalisé et à l'acquisition de nouvelles relations. - Offrir un conseil global en matière d'investissement, de prévoyance, de retraite et de planification patrimoniale. - Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'investissement adaptées au profil, aux objectifs et aux besoins de chaque client. - Développer des solutions adaptées aux besoins de la clientèle et favoriser l'adoption des services numériques. - Contribuer au développement et au rayonnement de l'activité de gestion de fortune par des actions de prospection et de représentation.
**Qu'apportez-vous?**
· Formation bancaire complète (CFC bancaire ou titre jugé équivalent), assortie de la certification SAQ CWMA ou disposé-e à l'obtenir dans le cadre de la fonction. - Brevet fédéral, formation supérieure ou spécialisation en gestion patrimoniale, un atout. - Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de fortune ou le conseil en investissement - Solides compétences en prévoyance et capacité à adopter une approche globale du patrimoine. - Personnalité entreprenante, autonome et orientée solutions. - Esprit commercial affirmé et connaissance du tissu économique local. - Domicilié-e en Suisse, idéalement dans le Chablais.
**Nous travaillons dans un environnement convivial**
Les valeurs coopératives sont nos piliers. Ensemble. Les uns pour les autres. Elles façonnent notre manière de collaborer et de nous comporter les uns envers les autres. La culture du tutoiement favorise la proximité personnelle et des échanges sur un pied d'égalité à tous les échelons de fonction.
**Nous vivons la diversité et l'égalité des chances**
Nous encourageons la diversité des perspectives, des expériences et des compétences au sein de nos équipes. Cette diversité fait notre richesse et contribue de manière décisive à notre réussite.
**Nous encourageons le développement personnel et professionnel**
L'apprentissage tout au long de la vie fait partie intégrante de notre culture. Nous créons un espace propice au développement professionnel et personnel de chacune et chacun et soutenons nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs de manière ciblée, grâce à une offre de formation interne variée ainsi qu'à une participation aux frais de perfectionnement externe.
**Nous offrons des conditions et des prestations sociales attractives**
Nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs bénéficient d'avantages exclusifs sur les produits bancaires, de diverses réductions auprès de tiers ainsi que d'une stabilité financière et d'une prévoyance vieillesse supérieure à la moyenne.

Als Founding SDR baust du unseren Inbound Lead-to-Demo-Prozess und kurbelst so unser Wachstum weiter an.
Wieso praxipal?
Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzt. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten.
Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten, aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen.

Du findest smarte Wege, verloren geglaubte Leads wieder zu reaktivieren, und holst so Potenzial zurück, das andere längst abgeschrieben hätten
Du steuerst deine Pipeline, pflegst unser CRM und machst deine Lead-to-Demo-Conversion über Daten messbar und optimierbar
Du baust praxipals Go-to-Market-Motion von Grund auf mit auf: Du entwickelst Playbooks und Gesprächsleitfäden, die zum Standard für unser wachsendes Sales-Team werden

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team.

You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal ’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal ’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal . As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

s.h: In the first week, expect to
s.t:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal .
Learn Toptal ’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
Learn the breadth of Toptal ’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal .
Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

s.h: In the first month, expect to
s.t:
Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

s.h: In the first three months, expect to
s.t:
Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal .
Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

s.h: In the first six months, expect to
s.t:
Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal ’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

s.h: In the first year, expect to
s.t:
Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal , our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.

Bachelor’s degree is required.
1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR.
Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients.
Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.
Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.

**Location:** Zurich (with flexibility to work across Switzerland)

**Help organisations stay one step ahead of cyber threats **
Cyber attacks are no longer a question of if, but when. While prevention remains important, organisations increasingly rely on their ability to detect threats early, respond effectively, and recover quickly.
At Deloitte, we help some of Switzerland's largest and most critical organisations build and transform their cyber defence capabilities. From designing Cyber Defence Centres and Security Operations Centres to improving incident response, deploying security technologies, and exploring AI-enabled security operations, we help our clients strengthen their resilience against an ever-evolving threat landscape.
If you are passionate about cyber defence, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, this is the opportunity for you.
**How you can make an impact **
As a Cyber Detect & Respond Advisor, you will work alongside experienced cyber professionals to help clients prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats and attacks.

* Assess and improve cyber defence capabilities, including Security Operations Centres (SOC), Cyber Defence Centres (CDC), Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, and Vulnerability Management
* Help clients design practical and effective cyber defence strategies, operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
* Design, implement, configure, and optimise cyber defence technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management platforms
* Support the development of detection use cases, monitoring capabilities, automation workflows, and security operations processes
* Conduct cyber defence assessments, maturity reviews, and benchmarking exercises to identify improvement opportunities
* Support incident response readiness activities, including playbook development, tabletop exercises, and crisis preparedness initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help clients understand how innovations such as AI-powered security operations can enhance detection and response capabilities
* Work closely with specialists across Deloitte to deliver integrated cyber security solutions that create measurable value for clients
* Contribute to business development, thought leadership, and the continued growth of Deloitte's Detect & Respond practice

We are looking for curious and motivated professionals who combine technical expertise with a desire to make a real impact. You bring:
* Approximately 5+ years of professional experience in cyber security, cyber defence, security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, cyber engineering, or a related field
* A passion for helping organisations prepare for and respond to cyber threats
* Practical experience in one or more areas such as Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, Digital Forensics, or Cyber Defence
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, XSIAM, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, EDR, NDR, SIEM, or similar solutions
* Understanding of modern threat actors, attack techniques, and cyber defence best practices
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* Curiosity, drive, and a desire to continuously learn and develop

* Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Cyber Defence Centre (CDC), CSIRT, or Incident Response team
* Exposure to AI-enabled security operations, security automation, detection engineering, or threat validation
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent
* University degree in a relevant field (Bachelor's or Master's)
* Fluent English; German and/or French are an advantage
**Your team**
You will join a diverse, international, and highly collaborative team of cyber security professionals who are passionate about helping organisations strengthen their resilience against cyber threats.
What makes our team different is the opportunity to work across the full cyber defence lifecycle. One day you may be helping a client define their future Cyber Defence Centre strategy, the next designing security monitoring capabilities, improving incident response processes, or supporting the implementation of leading security technologies.
We believe that great careers are built through challenging work, continuous learning, and strong support. You will benefit from hands-on experience, dedicated mentoring, professional certifications, and collaboration with experts across Deloitte's global network.
Most importantly, we foster an open and inclusive culture where people are encouraged to bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and shape the future of cyber defence.
Ready to make an impact?
Join us and help organisations build the capabilities they need to detect threats faster, respond smarter, and emerge stronger from cyber incidents. Your next challenge starts here.
**Careers at Deloitte. **
Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects.

At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation.

With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing.

You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn.
Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers.
